fact: Annir, an independent Libyan civil initiative, ran a technical and legal assessment between May 2023 and Q1 2024 of four Libyan digital laws (Law 22/2010, Law 5/2022, Law 6/2022, Law 4/1990) with academics among the participants, and published its findings.
title: مبادرة مدنية للإصلاح الرقمي: قراءة في أثر القوانين على سياسات الإنترنت في ليبيا
